items.name: reparto-processes-table
items.title: Reparto Processes Table
items.description: Editable reparto process list skin using the canonical @mano8/astro-ui-m8 controlled data-table block.

items.name: reparto-state-panel
items.title: Reparto State Panel
items.description: Reparto loading, empty, error, and unauthorized state adapter backed by the canonical @mano8/astro-ui-m8 state blocks.

items.name: reparto-starter-views
items.title: Reparto Starter Views
items.description: Starter copied skins for the reparto dashboard, meeting, processes, teacher, shared, versions, and exports islands. Requires @mano8/astro-reparto-m8 installed.

items.name: reparto-crud-table
items.title: Reparto CRUD Table
items.description: Generic admin CRUD table skin composing the canonical @mano8/astro-ui-m8 data-table and state blocks, with create action and loading/empty/error adapters.

items.name: reparto-fk-select
items.title: Reparto FK Select
items.description: Cascading select skin populated from a reparto list hook, with one-level inline create. Honours the freeze rule (D-7): no nested modals beyond one level.

items.name: reparto-delete-confirm
items.title: Reparto Delete Confirm
items.description: Relationship-aware destructive confirmation skin (AlertDialog) for hard-delete entities. Includes the entity label and record name per the freeze.

items.name: reparto-school-dialog
items.title: Reparto School Dialog
items.description: Create/edit dialog for schools (edit-only, no delete). Composes reparto hooks and the i18n dictionary.

items.name: reparto-academic-year-dialog
items.title: Reparto Academic Year Dialog
items.description: Create/edit/archive dialog for academic years. Date-only inputs (no timezone round-trip). Honours the archive-not-delete freeze rule.

items.name: reparto-department-dialog
items.title: Reparto Department Dialog
items.description: Create/edit dialog for departments with a cascading School FK select and one-level inline create link. Edit-only (no delete).

items.name: reparto-teacher-roster-dialog
items.title: Reparto Teacher Roster Dialog
items.description: Create/edit/delete dialog for teacher roster entries. Hard delete with relationship-aware confirm.
